# Regional Totals Summary Report

## Overview
This report summarizes the regional transaction data from the available records in `/workspace/data/records.csv`.

## Data Summary
- **Total Records Processed**: 18 records
- **Date Generated**: 2026-11-07

## Regional Totals

| Region | Amount (cents) | Amount (dollars) |
|--------|-----------------|-----------------|
| South  | 257,703         | $2,577.03       |
| West   | 324,174         | $3,241.74       |
| North  | 380,102         | $3,801.02       |
| **TOTAL** | **962,079** | **$9,620.79** |

## Data Quality Note
The input file contained 18 records (R002-R024, excluding R001, R005, R009, R013, R017, R021) instead of the 24 records expected per the job specifications. The totals above represent the complete and accurate sum of all 18 records found in the input file. Six records were missing from the provided dataset.

## Conclusion
Regional analysis shows the North region had the highest total transaction value at $3,801.02, followed by the West at $3,241.74 and South at $2,577.03. Combined total processed: $9,620.79 across 18 records.
